title: MK Monarch acknowledged

tellings.quote:
My friend Emma has a show called
Imagination Podcast that was on YouTube
about MK Monarch, which link I sent you
has been acknowledged.

plain: A secret programme called MK Monarch, which the teller treats as real, has now been officially acknowledged, according to Kurt Metzger, a guest on the show. Metzger says he got this from a friend he names only as Emma, who made an episode about MK Monarch on her YouTube show, Imagination Podcast, and he says he sent Michels the link.
